text.en: The Uttaramerur draw took place in full view of the community, often at a temple, to ensure fairness.
Because the draw was often held at a temple, the temple chose who would win.
The inscription does not tell us how names reached the leaves.
The main reason given for the public draw is that it saved time.

explanation.en: The draw took place in full view of the community to ensure fairness. A temple was often the place of the draw, and nothing says the temple chose the result. Our source does not tell us how every name came to be on a leaf, so the fairness of the draw does not settle that question.

hints.en: Separate what the source states from what it leaves unsaid.
The place of the draw is a different matter from who chose the result.
